Where can I get some quality blasters?''"''<br />''"''I wouldn't be too picky, being on the run like you obviously are.|Pablo and Cad Bane|<ref name="Friends and Enemies">{{TCW|Friends and Enemies}}</ref>}}
'''Pablo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] who was based in [[Pablo's pawnshop/Legends|his pawnshop]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], alongside [[Pablo's Twi'lek partner/Legends|his Twi'lek helper]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:PablosPawnshop-FAE.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Pablo attends to customers in his shop]]
When [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] (disguised as [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]]) were on the run, they obtained some items from Pablo's shop. When Pablo tried to sell more items to the trio, Bane responded by stating that his supply of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] was insufficient. When Pablo spoke of their current situation, Bane held his toothpick near Pablo's throat and warned him to keep his mouth shut.
